description: Frozen iqa_agent benchmark: 410 labelled dev rows (train/val, subject-disjoint) + 610-image frozen eval (labels held out of the method's data dir). Label-gap classes are filled offline: local_largemodel/qwen3.8-27b proposes candidate defect labels (scripts/iqa_annotate.py, prompt iqa-prelabel-v1) and every candidate goes through human review before it can enter a dataset version; classes with no measurable support receive severity-matched augmentation (see the data plan in the research report).
isolation: subject-group-disjoint train/val; eval labels never exposed to the method; augmentation never touches the frozen eval in the same protocol version
